document.title: Instructions for Form PENS.E/3-A — Spouse Married After Separation: Expression of Interest to Purchase an Annuity

chunks.heading: Purpose of form PENS.E/3-A
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/3-A notifies UNJSPF of a retiree's interest in purchasing an annuity for a spouse married after separation, so that spouse can become eligible for a survivor's benefit.

chunks.heading: Who is a 'spouse married after separation'
chunks.text: A person who marries a retiree after the date of the retiree's separation from the service of their employing organization.

chunks.heading: Eligibility rule for a spouse married after separation
chunks.text: Under article 35 ter, a spouse married after separation is not eligible for a widow's or widower's benefit unless the retiree purchases an annuity for that spouse.

chunks.heading: Who can purchase the annuity
chunks.text: A retiree who is receiving a periodic benefit may elect to purchase an annuity for a spouse married after separation.

chunks.heading: Process and deadline for purchasing the annuity
chunks.text: The retiree should submit form PENS.E/3-A as soon as possible after the marriage. After UNJSPF determines eligibility and provides an estimate of the annuity cost, the retiree must confirm the final election by submitting form PENS.E/3-B; the purchase will not proceed without a signed PENS.E/3-B. The election must be made within one year of the date of the marriage, or the retiree will be deemed ineligible upon review.

chunks.heading: Section 1: retiree information
chunks.text: Provide UID, full name, date of birth, and contact information. To verify identity for MSS support, include full name, last employing organization before separation, last duty station, and five-digit alphanumeric retirement number in the UID request email.

chunks.heading: Section 2 and 3: spouse and marriage information
chunks.text: Section 2 requires the spouse's full name, date of birth, and contact information. Section 3 requires the date and place of the marriage.

chunks.heading: How to submit form PENS.E/3-A
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form must be returned directly to UNJSPF, either via MSS Document Upload (scanned JPG/JPEG/PDF) or by mail to UNJSPF's New York or Geneva offices.
